theme_strategy.rationale: Astrology and cosmic themes naturally align with dark interfaces (night sky). Dark mode allows golden accents and starlight silver text to glow, enhancing the premium 'Gold Medalist' positioning.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-serif font-light text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight font-serif font-medium text-amber-200

rules: NEVER use generic fonts (Inter/Roboto) for headings.
Use Cormorant Garamond for all primary titles to give a spiritual, authoritative Vedic feel.
Always use tight letter spacing on large text.

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Mystery) blended with Cosmic Mysticism
rules: Use tinted greys (cool blue/purple undertones) instead of pure black.
Limit the primary gold color to CTAs and important highlights.

glassmorphism.rule: NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.

cards_bento.classes: bg-card border border-border/50 hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors duration-300 rounded-2xl

textures: Add a subtle CSS noise overlay to the hero section to kill digital flatness.
Use radial gradients sparingly to create a 'glow' behind golden elements (e.g., bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-amber-900/20 via-transparent to-transparent).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or soft-rounded (rounded-xl) with a glowing hover effect. Primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-amber-300.
components.inputs: bg-muted_nebula border-white/10 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-xl text-white.
components.tabs: Custom Shadcn tabs for Daily/Weekly/Monthly horoscopes. Override fixed heights. Active tab should have a golden bottom border or golden text.
components.chat_interface: Use a specialized glassmorphic container for the AI Astrologer. User messages: muted background. AI messages: subtle gold/nebula tint.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for dashboard cards and sections. Use massive vertical padding (py-24 or py-32) for landing page sections.
grids_and_layouts.marketing_page: Asymmetric layouts. Large portrait of Acharya Akash overlapping a cosmic background. Text heavy on one side, visual heavy on the other.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid (MODE B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Charts span 2 cols, small metrics (moon phase, lucky color) span 1 col.

motion.hover_states: Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase glow. Cards get a border color shift to gold/amber.
motion.marquee: Use a slow-moving editorial ribbon for zodiac signs separating the hero and the pricing section.

image_urls.description: Deep space nebula - use as Hero background overlay with opacity-40
Star cluster - use for AI Chat background or Pricing section background
Golden zodiac wheel - use in the Birth Chart generation section or Dashboard
Spiritual elderly man in yellow/gold - use as the portrait for Acharya Akash on the landing page

media.icons_library: lucide-react (default). Use thin strokes for mystical feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over nebula backgrounds has sufficient contrast (use bg-black/50 overlays or text-shadows).
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Run 'npm install framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react sonner react-router-dom react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod'
Add UI components: 'npx shadcn-ui@latest add button input select card dialog form tabs dropdown-menu sonner'
CRITICAL: Generate all components as `.js` or `.jsx` files, NOT `.tsx` files.
Initialize standard Shadcn and apply the dark mode config provided in the css variables.
Build a Landing Page routing to `/` and Dashboard routing to `/dashboard`.
On the landing page, create a grand introduction for Acharya Akash (Gold Medalist) with his portrait and credentials.
Implement the Dashboard with a Bento Grid layout for Horoscope, Birth Chart, and Compatibility.
Create a beautiful pricing page (₹999, ₹1499 packages) and premium subscription toggle.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or soft-rounded) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
MUST use the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text for images.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
